package.name: hex_slam
package.description: Dedicated SLAM package for the hex2 hexapod. Fuses ground-truth simulated odometry (from hex_gazebo's OdometryPublisher) with IMU via robot_localization, then runs slam_toolbox against the existing /scan to build a 2D map. Does not modify hex_description or hex_gazebo's controllers/sensors - only adds nodes downstream of their existing, unmodified topics.
